2012 CaH6-王晖.pdf · 第 1 页：Hydrogen-rich compounds hold promise as high-temperature superconductors under high pressures. Recent theoretical hydride structures on achieving high-pressure superconductivity are composed mainly of \mathbf { H _ { 2 } } fragments. Through a systematic investigation of Ca hydrides with different hydrogen contents using particleswam optimization structural search, we show that in the stoichiometry \mathsf { C a H _ { 6 } } a body-centered cubic structure with hydrogen that forms unusual“sodalite" cagescontainingenclathratedCa stabilizes above pressure 150 GPa. The stability of this structure is derived from the acceptance bytwo \mathbf { H _ { 2 } } of electrons donated by Ca forming an \mathbf { H _ { 4 } } unitas the building block in the construction of the three-dimensional sodalite cage. This unique structure has a partial occupationof thedegenerated orbitals at the zone center. The resultant dynamicJahn–Teller effecthelps to enhance electronphonon coupling and leads to superconductivity of \mathbf { C a H _ { 6 } } . A superconducting critical temperature ( \mathbf { I } _ { c } ) of 220–235 K at 150 GPa obtained from the solution of the Eliashberg equations is the highest among all hydrides studied thus far.

该标题可作为科学贡献概括保留。正文第1页明确报道理论预测的CaH6具有包合Ca的氢方钠石笼状结构，并预测其在150 GPa下的Tc为220–235 K，支持“theoretically predicted”“HTSC”和“clathrate hydride CaH6”。“first”的历史优先性还得到人工提供的2021年综述直接支持：其第5–6页明确称Im-3m CaH6为首个预测Tc超过200 K的笼型超氢化物，并将该结论归于当前2012年论文。这里的“first”应限定为高温超导笼型氢化物这一类别，不能扩大为首个理论预测的超导氢化物；原文引言已指出此前其他氢化物存在10–139 K的理论预测。
